http/cache_validation#

Revalidating a stale cached response (RFC 9111 §4.3): the conditional request, and the entry a 304 refreshes.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Revalidating a stale cached response (RFC 9111 §4.3): the conditional request, and the entry a 304 refreshes. Caching uses it.

Public API#

object CacheValidation

One selected complete variant, conservative received validator matching.
